MoltenVK 1.4.2
source:    https://github.com/KhronosGroup/MoltenVK/releases/download/v1.4.2/MoltenVK-macos.tar
released:  2026-07-24
retrieved: 2026-08-19
sha256:    f95765a6229cb7b915990a2890ce12ebe36a730b021545d3d52ae69ce4c4024e  (MoltenVK-macos.tar)
license:   Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt)

Vendored because vcpkg has no molten-vk port. Only the macOS dynamic ICD is kept
from the 57 MB tarball; the xcframework, static libs, headers and docs are not.

libMoltenVK.dylib and MoltenVK_icd.json MUST stay in the same directory: the
manifest's "library_path" is the relative "./libMoltenVK.dylib".

Verified on retrieval (Apple M1 Pro, loader 1.4.350):
  device apiVersion 1.3.357  -> clears the backend's >=1.3 requirement
  VK_KHR_portability_subset  advertised (the backend enables it)
  dynamicRendering / synchronization2 / timelineSemaphore  all supported
